title: Photobleaching FRET-FLIM-ICS for quaternary structure quantification on cells. Theory and simulations.
journal: Biochimica et biophysica acta. General subjects
one_liner_zh: 该文提出结合光漂白FRET-FLIM与图像相关光谱的模拟方法量化细胞中蛋白质寡聚态，虽涉及转录因子寡聚化但未聚焦TF-DNA结合互作，且方法为荧光成像模拟而非AI或分子动力学模拟，与课题核心关联较弱。
abstract: The oligomerization of proteins is an important biological control mechanism and has several functions in activity and stability of enzymes, structural proteins, ion channels and transcription factors. The determination of the relevant oligomeric states in terms of geometry (spatial extent), oligomer size (monomer or dimer or oligomer) and affinity (amounts of monomer, dimer and oligomer) is a challenging biophysical problem. Forster resonance energy transfer and fluorescence fluctuation spectroscopy are powerful tools that are sensitive to proximity and oligomerization respectively. Here it is proposed to combine image-based lifetime-detected Forster resonance energy transfer with image correlation spectroscopy and photobleaching to determine distances, oligomer sizes and oligomer distributions. Simulations for simple oligomeric forms illustrate the potential to improve the discrimination between different quaternary states in the cellular milieu.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质的寡聚化是一种重要的生物控制机制，在酶、结构蛋白、离子通道和转录因子的活性与稳定性中发挥多种功能。确定相关的寡聚状态，包括几何形状（空间范围）、寡聚体大小（单体、二聚体或寡聚体）及亲和力（单体、二聚体和寡聚体的数量），是一个具有挑战性的生物物理问题。福斯特共振能量转移和荧光波动光谱学是分别对邻近性和寡聚化敏感的强大工具。本文提出将基于图像的寿命检测福斯特共振能量转移与图像相关光谱学和光漂白相结合，以确定距离、寡聚体大小和寡聚体分布。针对简单寡聚形式的模拟展示了在细胞环境中改善不同四级结构状态区分能力的潜力。
